abilities.name: Tidecaller
abilities.caveat: The hold shield guards only the caster and lasts just the brief moment of the parry, so it is not drawn as a lasting shield window.
_curatorNotes: Hold mechanic modeled via gcsim `counter` param (0=press/no hits absorbed, 1=1 hit, 2=max/perfect parry). All variants share the same skillFrames slice. Hold-phase shield in gcsim lasts only until skillHitmark (23 frames ≈ 0.38s) — cast-time absorption, not a persistent summon. Reviewer to decide whether to model tap/hold variants with separate frames.

2026-07-12 (tag-without-effect pass): shield effect authored — 25.9% Max HP + 3050 at talent level 10 (sidecar 'Shield DMG Absorption' row, 10th column: '25.9% Max HP+3050'; gcsim beidou_gen.go shieldPer[9]=0.2592, shieldBase[9]=3050.2405). target 'self': gcsim skill.go Shields.Add uses Target=c.Index() (Beidou herself), matching the kit's 'Lifts her weapon up as a shield' — a self parry, not a party shield. Effect duration omitted — gcsim sets Expires = c.Core.F + skillHitmark (23f ≈ 0.38s), which models the instant-cast release, not the player-held brace window; a fixed duration would misstate the hold-timing use (mirrors Yun Jin Opening Flourish, also a duration-omitted self parry shield). 250% Electro DMG Absorption Efficiency and the Electro self-application are not modeled.
abilities.description:
Nothing to worry about. Should anyone raise a hand against her or her men, she will avenge it ten-fold with sword and thunder.

Press
Accumulating the power of lightning, Beidou swings her blade forward fiercely, dealing Electro DMG.

Hold
Lifts her weapon up as a shield. Max DMG absorbed scales off Beidou's Max HP.
Attacks using the energy stored within the greatsword upon release or once this ability's duration expires, dealing Electro DMG. DMG dealt scales with the number of times Beidou is attacked in the skill's duration. The greatest DMG Bonus will be attained once this effect is triggered twice.
The shield possesses the following properties:
·Has 250% Electro DMG Absorption Efficiency.
·Applies the Electro element to Beidou upon activation.

Not a spawned entity — not modeled as summons[]. `duration` field removed from ability level per recipe. Reviewer to decide representation for the 15s off-field lightning discharge window.
abilities.description:
Recalling her slaying of the great beast Haishan, Beidou calls upon that monstrous strength and the lightning to create a Thunderbeast's Targe around herself, dealing Electro DMG to nearby opponents.

Thunderbeast's Targe
·When Normal and Charged Attacks hit, they create a lightning discharge that can jump between opponents, dealing Electro DMG.
·Increases the character's resistance to interruption, and decreases DMG taken.

A maximum of 1 lightning discharge can be triggered per second.

passives.name: Polaris
passives.caveat: Shown as 8 Energy per held release; in game it is 8 per stack of power, and only when the released hit connects. Not modeled: the 4s-per-stack skill CD cut, or the Radiance: Stellar-Conduct state gained inside a Polestar Field.
_curatorNotes: 2026-07-29 Stellar-Conduct round: Polaris is Beidou's Witch's Revelation Passive (Fandom page 'Polaris', Change History = Luna VIII), unlocked by the world quest 'Witch's Revelation: Voyaging Instruction'. gcsim ships no Stellar code, so the Fandom wiki is the sole evidence for this whole passive.

Energy effect: wiki text — 'holding down to unleash Tidecaller and hitting the opponent also gives extra boosts based on the power accumulated: every stack active decreases Beidou's Elemental Skill CD by 4s, as well as regenerates 8 Elemental Energy for her. This effect can trigger once every 15s.' Authored as a FIXED amount 8 with procCooldown 15 on onCast skill: the per-stack multiplier is not expressible, and the tidecaller ability carries no press/hold variants, so the hold-release-that-hits gate cannot be attached. The stack ceiling is undocumented (1 stack / 0.8s held; the wiki says the skill can be held for up to 3s, itself flagged {{Verify}}).

CD reduction (-4s per stack, same 15s proc window) NOT authored: the amount is per-stack (variable) and the gate is a hold-release that hits — cooldownReduce takes a fixed amount and is parser-deferred anyway. Belongs to the deferred CD-modification queue; the caveat carries it. Skill cooldown left at 7.5s — the Fandom Tidecaller page still lists CD 7.5s and has no Luna VIII edit, so this is NOT a permanent CD patch.

Stack accumulation while holding (1 per 0.8s even when not under attack, raising the release DMG) not authored — damage magnitude plus stack machinery, per constitution. This clause is PERMANENT: no Polestar Field or Stellar-Conduct wording gates it.

Radiance: Stellar-Conduct — Polaris says only 'when inside a Polestar Field, Beidou will enter the Radiance: Stellar-Conduct state' and, unlike sibling Witch's Revelation passives (Yae Miko's 'Edict of Cleansing' carries an explicit "Radiance: Stellar-Conduct:" clause), the wiki documents NO payload for Beidou's state. Nothing authored, so no teamEnablesReaction condition and no gatedReactions for beidou. Re-check when the Polaris page gains a Radiance clause or Gameplay Notes.

game8 (secondary) framed the stack / -4s CD / 8-energy mechanics as happening 'in a Polestar Field'. The wiki disagrees: the Polestar Field wording attaches only to the Radiance state; the stack, CD and energy clauses are unconditional kit patches. Numbers (0.8s, 4s, 8 Energy, 15s) match between the two sources.
passives.description:
When holding down on the Elemental Skill Tidecaller, 1 stack of power will accumulate every 0.8s, even when not under attack. This increases the DMG dealt at the point of unleashing.
Additionally, holding down to unleash Tidecaller and hitting the opponent also gives extra boosts based on the power accumulated: every stack active decreases Beidou's Elemental Skill CD by 4s, as well as regenerates 8 Elemental Energy for her. This effect can trigger once every 15s.
Additionally, when inside a Polestar Field, Beidou will enter the Radiance: Stellar-Conduct state.
